question: Does 崔錫鼎《明谷集》卷十三 explain the older solar 盈縮加分 interpolation and 100刻/96刻 conversion, and can either identify G893's native 一秒八十六少 or settle any of its six historical finals?

source_identity.work: 明谷集 (also 明谷先生文集)
source_identity.received_target: 卷十三 / 書牘 / recurring heading 與李壽翁書; two distinct letters identified by their opening phrases, not one duplicate letter

institutional_bibliographic_claims.collected_and_edited: Author's son 崔昌大 and students compiled drafts after his death
institutional_bibliographic_claims.first_print: 1721 大邱監營 wooden-block edition, 34卷15冊
institutional_bibliographic_claims.facsimile_basis: 國立中央圖書館 한46-가1170; quoted introduction says some damaged leaves in juan 22-24 were substituted from SNU 奎1077
institutional_bibliographic_claims.manuscript_date_of_quoted_letters: UNBOUND; 1721 is the collection print date, not verified letter-composition date

source_identity.excluded_deduplication: Wikisource zh and wk mirror are the SAME received-text presentation, not two independent witnesses. The institutional edition description and received transcription do not automatically bind a given letter to an individually inspected 1721 woodblock leaf.

exact_passage_controls.locator: 卷十三 書牘 與李壽翁書; letter opening 昨書承悉; section 盈縮加分雲者
exact_passage_controls.witnessed_selective_text: 盈縮加分雲者。卽盈分縮分也。合而名曰盈縮加分。盈縮積雲者。乃加分之積
exact_passage_controls.interpretation: Author explicitly distinguishes per-day solar surplus/deficit increment (加分) from accumulated correction (盈縮積), and warns against treating the two solar modes as simultaneous multiplication.
exact_passage_controls.followup_short_text: 以加分乘之。萬約爲分。加諸盈縮積者

exact_passage_controls.locator: 卷十三 書牘 與李壽翁書; letter opening 日昨伻回
exact_passage_controls.witnessed_selective_text: 加分是經朔全日剩分。而今有日下若干分。則必以加分乘之。日法除之然後
exact_passage_controls.interpretation: Earlier letter distinguishes elapsed-day fractional part, multiplying tabular 加分 and dividing by 日法 before combining with 積分.

exact_passage_controls.locator: 卷十三 書牘 與李壽翁書; letter opening 伻回得手覆
exact_passage_controls.witnessed_selective_text: 盈縮法乘除之理。乃算法異乘同除也
exact_passage_controls.interpretation: Late-author correspondence calls the multiplication/division form 異乘同除, giving an example of the arithmetic idea, without establishing formula-source-copy identity.

exact_passage_controls.locator: same 伻回得手覆 letter, later paragraph beginning 今以刻法借明之朔實
exact_passage_controls.witnessed_selective_text: 若以西法九十六刻求之。則先以九十六。乘五十三。得五千。○八十八。復以刻法一百除之。方得五十刻八十八分
exact_passage_controls.interpretation: A separate timekeeping denominator translation uses 100刻→96刻. The passage ALSO analogizes this to solar interpolation, but does not say the two numerically different divisions share a historical unit or source page.

later_mingshi_received_formula.exact_section: 明史卷三十五 志第十一 推盈縮差
later_mingshi_received_formula.mechanic: 置初末曆小餘; multiply by 立成內所載盈縮加分; divide by 日周一萬; add to 盈縮積

deterministic_mechanical_crosscheck.explicit_field_firewall: The 100/96 ke ratio belongs to timekeeping, while 日周一萬 in later solar-difference procedures is a fractional-day divisor. A passage mentioning both does not license transferring 96/100 to solar fields, or reading source-native G893 一秒八十六少 as 微.

adjacent_unpromoted_day_boundary.source_context: Another letter in the same volume discusses 子初四刻以上則屬之昨日 and 8大2小刻, but it concerns 授時 calendar and counting conventions, NOT a Ziwei school-specifically attested late-Zi candidate.
adjacent_unpromoted_day_boundary.HPA_ZDATE_006_runtime_impact: NONE; P0 TW-OPEN-0006 stays pending original Ziwei edition evidence and independent time-coordinate formalization.

next_gate: Find provider-issued, source-original solar G893 same-column 少/微 and radix/carry instructions or actual SNU 奎貴67 upper/lower 盈縮加分 formula folio; alternatively secure an independent genuinely collated woodblock target leaf for 《明谷集》卷十三 if it can clarify textual variants at no cost.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: A received 1721 compiled Korean correspondence does not prove textual direct copying from a particular G893 physical copy.
同名盈縮加分 and shared multiplication/division are a rule-family comparison, not source-specific original solar field identity.
Adjacent hundred-ke to ninety-six-ke translation is a separate denominator, not a proof that G893 少 means 微 or any disputed historical numerical value.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Actual printing/folio and independently bound original glyphs for the two specific 《明谷集》卷十三 letters
Original G893 tabular units and 少/微 carry, plus the missing SNU 奎貴67 formula section
